Task:

- which candidate memories to READ;
- which current unit IDs to STORE and to which target;
- which current unit IDs to SKIP.

Format:
{
  "read": ["m1", "m3"],
  "store": [
    {"target": "service_memory", "unit_id": "u1"},
    {"target": "task_state", "unit_id": "u2"}
  ],
  "skip": ["u3"]
}

Legal STORE targets:
user_profile, project_memory, repo_memory, service_memory, task_state

Rules:
- READ useful memories only; skip merely related or stale ones.
- STORE durable, reusable information with correct target.
- SKIP sensitive, temporary, one-off, or out-of-scope content.
- Every current unit must appear exactly once in store or skip.
- Do not invent IDs, targets, or content.

RUNTIME_CONTEXT
project: cybersecurity-audit
repo: pentestkit
service: vuln-scanner
task: Working on the vuln-scanner in cybersecurity-audit

CANDIDATE_MEMORIES
m1 [service_memory] [STALE]: Deployment logs were a shared Google Doc before proper change management.
m2 [service_memory]: The vuln-scanner caches attack surface data in where with a ttl TTL. This relates to the remediation functionality.
m3 [service_memory] [STALE]: A static on-call rotation with no timezone awareness was the old schedule.
m4 [repo_memory]: The pentestkit CI blocks merges if the vuln-scanner condition by more than 10%. This relates to the remediation functionality.
m5 [service_memory] [STALE]: Flask+SQLite powered the prototype before FastAPI+PostgreSQL migration.

CURRENT_UNITS
u1: Discarded idea: add rate limiting per API key to the vuln-scanner. Rejected because it conflicts with the architecture roadmap. This relates to the CVSS score functionality.
u2: This sprint task: add circuit breaking for downstream calls to the vuln-scanner to handle the EU-WEST-1 region. Due by Q2 closing. This relates to the false positive functionality.
u3: The vuln-scanner performs operation — detail This is critical for false positive use cases.
{"read": ["m2", "m4"], "store": [{"target": "task_state", "unit_id": "u2"}, {"target": "service_memory", "unit_id": "u3"}], "skip": ["u1"]}
